title: Implement blobext-03 and object-history-03
description: blobext-03 and object-history-03 (posted 2026-11-02) took all 12 of Mark's 2026-11-01 list review points plus editorial (see JMAP-3a7m). crate-jmap has no server implementation of either draft: the only blob code is crate-jmap-chat-client/src/methods/blob.rs (Blob/lookup, Blob/convert client, citing blobext-01). Sources: /data/PROJECT/IETF/specs/draft-ietf-jmap-blobext-03.xml, draft-ietf-jmap-object-history-03.xml; upstream repos brong/draft-gondwana-jmap-blobext and brong/draft-gondwana-jmap-object-history are live again (commits 2026-11-03/04). Server implementation children are optional; do them only if these extensions are wanted.
notes:
Decision Mark 2026-11-12: crate-jmap aims to be THE complete reference implementation covering the JMAP specs, so this is required work, not optional. Split rule: the crates own wire types, validation, method semantics and error mapping; storage-, transport- or media-specific work is pushed to the calling crate through backend trait hooks (see the spec-method-defaults memory: no no-op default when that would put wrong data on the wire). Covers object-history-03 too, under the same complete-coverage rule.
2026-11-13: design doc docs/design/blobext.md (blob client, registry, sibling fixes, umbrella) and docs/design/object-history.md (sub-epic JMAP-tna1.3); decisions docs/design/DECISIONS.md. Children in dependency order (note key, id, size, title):
- sub-epic JMAP-tna1.2: blobext-03 server and RFC 9404 serving
- sub-epic JMAP-tna1.3: object-history-03
- B1 JMAP-tna1.4 [M] jmap-types: shared JMAP Data Types registry (blobext + object-history)
- B12 JMAP-tna1.5 [M] blob-client: jmap-blob-client bindings
- B13 JMAP-tna1.6 [S] base-client: BlobUploadResponse.expires
- B14 JMAP-tna1.1 [S] chat-client: update blob methods from blobext-01 to -03
- B15 JMAP-tna1.12 [S] chat-client: deprecate blob methods as thin wrappers over jmap-blob-client
- B16 JMAP-tna1.13 [S] chat-client: remove deprecated blob wrappers (next breaking release)
- B17 JMAP-tna1.7 [S] cid-types: re-cite RFC 9404 to blobext-03
- B20 JMAP-tna1.8 [M] mail-server: resolve #creationId in blobId-typed properties (canonical)
- B21 JMAP-tna1.9 [M] Propagate #creationId blobId resolution to filenode, scene, chat, contacts, calendars
- B22 JMAP-tna1.10 [S] jmap-blob: umbrella re-export crate (replaces the 0.0.1 placeholder)
- B24 JMAP-tna1.11 [S] blob-client: RFC 9404 bindings (Blob/upload, 9404 Blob/get and Blob/lookup)
JMAP-m4nc (RFC 9404 jmap-blob) closed and folded in (decision 4).
